subject: gk
question: Who as the Governor, administered Oath to the Chief Minister of Kerala Pinarayi Vijayan in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Shri Arif Mohammed Khan__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Arif Mohammad Khan is a politician from India who is now the Governor of Kerala.
 
• He was once a Union Minister.
 
• He has held a variety of portfolios, from energy to civil aviation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Biswabhusan Harichandan is the second and former Governor of Andhra Pradesh in India (Present Governor of Andhra Pradesh** Sri S. Abdul Nazeer**).
 
• Governor of Rajasthan, Kalraj Mishra, is an Indian politician. He is a former Himachal Pradesh Governor and Cabinet Minister for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.
 
• Shriniwas Dadasaheb Patil is an Indian politician and former Indian Administrative Service Officer. He is a member of the Lok Sabha representing Maharashtra's Satara seat.
